requirements_summary.summary: Participium enables citizens to report urban issues in Turin via a web platform or Telegram bot, managed by municipal offices and external maintainers. It covers registration, report submission, status lifecycle, notifications, statistics, and internal coordination rules.

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to assign reports to external maintainers
So that specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention.
constraints: It can be possible for specific reports of certain categories (e.g., Enel X for category Public Lighting) based on their content reviewed by the technical office staff member.
Assignment possible for specific categories (e.g., Public Lighting) based on content review
expected_behaviors: specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention
External maintainer can handle and update the intervention

requirements.text:
As an external maintainer 
I want to update the status of a report assigned to me
So that I can updated citizens about  the intervention.
constraints: Only if company has access to Participium (Case 1)
expected_behaviors: I can updated citizens about  the intervention
Status moves from Assigned to In Progress
External maintainer can resolve the report

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member/external maintainer
I want to exchange information and comments on the report internally
So that coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens
constraints: Comments are reserved and not visible to reporter or citizens
expected_behaviors: coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens
Coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to register with my name and username 
So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
constraints: Registration is required before submitting reports.
Email is mandatory field
Registration required before submitting reports
expected_behaviors: I can access the Participium system and submit reports
User gets email with confirmation code after registration

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to confirm my registration with a code
So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
constraints: Once a registration is completed, the user gets an email with a confirmation code. The person can use the application only after confirming by entering the code valid for 30 minutes.
Code valid for 30 minutes
expected_behaviors: my account becomes valid and I can start using the system
Account becomes valid after entering code

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to set up municipality users
constraints: These are the internal accounts of the municipality
These are internal accounts of the municipality
expected_behaviors: Users created for municipal staff

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to assign roles to municipality users
constraints: Possible roles: municipal public relations officer, municipal administrator, technical office staff member, external maintainer. You can be more specific on technical offices to run realisti scenarios following the official organizational structure of the municipality of Turin (https://trasparenza.comune.torino.it/media/2212/download)
Possible roles: municipal public relations officer, municipal administrator, technical office staff member, external maintainer
expected_behaviors: Modification includes cancellation
Municipality user can have multiple roles

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to provide details for my report 
So that the the problem is classified correctly.
constraints: Mandatory fields: title, description,  category , photos (min 1 max 3).
Mandatory fields: title, description, category, photos (min 1 max 3)
expected_behaviors: the the problem is classified correctly
Problem classified correctly based on input

requirements.text:
As a municipal public relations officer
I want to review and approve or reject reports 
So that only valid reports are processed further.
constraints: Rejected reports must include an explanation. If accepted, the report is assigned to the technical office bound to the report category.
Rejected reports must include an explanation
expected_behaviors: only valid reports are processed further
Accepted reports assigned to technical office bound to category

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to see the list of reports assigned to me
So that I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done
expected_behaviors: I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done
Overview of maintenance to be done displayed

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to configure my account
So that I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence.
constraints: Citizens can  upload a personal photo, add their Telegram username and switch off/on email notifications in the configuration panel.
Can upload personal photo, add Telegram username, switch off/on email notifications
expected_behaviors: I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence
Account settings saved in configuration panel

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to modify roles to municipality users
So that the staff can be more flexible.
constraints: This story overwrites a previous answer given by PO on the Telegram chat. NB: 1) A municipality user can now have multiple roles, i.e. serving on more than one technical office. 2) Modification includes cancellation.
Modification includes cancellation
expected_behaviors: the staff can be more flexible
Staff flexibility increased

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member 
I want to update report statuses 
So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
constraints: At each status change, the citizen receives notification in the platform with the corresponding update. Municipal operators working on reports can also send messages to the citizens in the platform, to which the citizen can reply.
At each status change, citizen receives notification
expected_behaviors: citizens are informed of the problem resolution process
Citizen informed of problem resolution process

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to reply to messages from municipal operators in the platform 
So that I can communicate directly about my report.
constraints: Two-way communication is possible within the platform.
expected_behaviors: I can communicate directly about my report
Two-way communication possible within platform

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to follow reports done by other citizens 
So that I can be updated
constraints: Only not closed reports can be followed. Notifications follow the  the same rules as for owned reports.
Only not closed reports can be followed
expected_behaviors: I can be updated
Notifications follow same rules as owned reports

requirements.text:
As a municipal administrator
I want to configure automatic assignment of all reports in a certain category
So that interventions will be faster.
constraints: Possible only if previously set by municipal administrator
expected_behaviors: interventions will be faster
Interventions faster without initial review

requirements.text:
As a citizen/unregistered user
I want to browse a summary table of reports with filters 
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports.
constraints: Filters: by category, status, period of time
expected_behaviors: I can easily explore and analyze existing reports
Data from table filtered for analysis

domain_rules: Reports statuses: Pending Approval, Assigned, In Progress, Suspended, Rejected, Resolved.
Rejected reports must include an explanation from Municipality Organization Office.
Once a report has been inserted, it cannot be modified or deleted by the citizen.
Public Relation officer can assign report to specific technical office or directly to staff member.
External maintainers added by system administrator; each maintainer should have own individual account.
Case 1: External company has access to Participium (internal comments reserved).
Case 2: External company does not have access (technical office updates status externally).
Automatic assignment of all issues of a certain category possible only if previously set by municipal administrator.
Email is mandatory field for registration; can also be used for login.
Confirmation code valid for 30 minutes after registration.
Categories: Water Supply, Architectural Barriers, Sewer System, Public Lighting, Waste, Road Signs and Traffic Lights, Roads and Urban Furnishings, Public Green Areas and Playgrounds, Other.
Anonymous user name visible to staff but hidden in public map for citizens.
Notifications/messages can be set to real time or when page is refreshed.
Public statistics visible on site include number of reports by category and trends.
Private statistics for administrators include detailed breakdowns by status, type, reporter.
edge_cases: External maintainer resolves report only if they have access to Participium (Case 1).
Technical office staff member resolves report if external company has no access (Case 2).
Anonymous name hidden in public map but visible to staff.
Reports grouped into cumulative report when zooming out on map.
Only not closed reports can be followed by citizens.
assumptions: Specific technical offices structure based on Turin municipality official organizational chart.
Unregistered users can view reports (visitors) since sprint 4.
Telegram bot allows creating new report via guided process.
Citizens can upload personal photo and Telegram username in configuration panel.
System supports both public and private statistics display.

GET /sessions/current validates the current session state.
Registration is public but subsequent profile access requires authentication.
Admin endpoints require elevated privileges and valid sessions.
Public report list (/reports/approved) does not require authentication.

strategy_items.requirement_summary:
As a citizen
I want to register with my name and username 
So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute registration for a new citizen user. Verify account creation and email confirmation code generation.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Reset environment to remove test user account
strategy_items.rationale: Validates successful citizen registration and account creation flow as per requirement PT01.

strategy_items.requirement_summary:
As a municipal administrator
I want to configure automatic assignment of all reports in a certain category
So that interventions will be faster.
strategy_items.prompt: Attempt automatic maintainer assignment without prior configuration. Verify failure response when auto-assignment rules are not set.
setup_needed: Create a report resource via POST /reports
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the report resource associated with this assignment
strategy_items.rationale: Tests behavior when automatic assignment is attempted without prior configuration, ensuring safety constraints are enforced.

strategy_items.requirement_summary:
As a technical office staff member 
I want to update report statuses 
So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
strategy_items.prompt: Update an existing report status from Pending Approval to Assigned. Verify notification trigger and state transition.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Create a report resource via POST /reports
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the report resource associated with this status update
strategy_items.rationale: Validates status transition workflow and notification trigger for resolution process as per requirement PT11.

strategy_items.requirement_summary:
As a technical office staff member
I want to assign reports to external maintainers
So that specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention.
strategy_items.prompt: Assign an external maintainer to a report. Verify assignment logic respects category constraints (e.g., Public Lighting).
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Create a report resource via POST /reports
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the report resource associated with this assignment
strategy_items.rationale: Tests external maintainer assignment logic, including category-specific constraints and spelling variations in endpoint.

strategy_items.requirement_summary:
As a technical office staff member/external maintainer
I want to exchange information and comments on the report internally
So that coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens
strategy_items.prompt: Create an internal comment for a report. Verify comment creation and subsequent listing of comments.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member/external maintainer.
Create a report resource via POST /reports
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the report resource associated with this comment creation
strategy_items.rationale: Validates internal comment creation and stateful dependency for listing comments as per requirement PT26.
